name: @thaipass/proxy
description: OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions and Anthropic-compatible /v1/messages in front of the AI Pass (de.aipass.net) chat backend.

scripts.build: bun build src/app.ts --target=bun --outfile dist/app.js --external 'elysia' --external '@elysiajs/*' --external 'evlog' --external 'evlog/*' --external '@t3-oss/*' --external 'zod' --external '@ai-sdk/*' --banner '// Bundled from src/app.ts by bun build with @thaipass/core inlined; the imports from "elysia" and the other dependencies stay external for Vercel to trace.'
